name: Time
description: First-class current date/time awareness for agents: an active mechanism (shell `date`) to obtain the real current time instead of guessing from stale training data.

timezone.label: Timezone override
timezone.description: Blank (default) uses the host machine's local timezone via plain `date`. Set an IANA name (e.g. 'America/Chicago') to pin timestamps to that zone via `TZ='<value>' date`.

timestampFormat.label: Timestamp format
timestampFormat.description: `date` format for timestamps. `iso-8601`: machine-sortable (`2026-07-09T18:58:06-05:00`). `friendly` (default): readable with weekday (`2026-07-09 18:58 CDT (Thursday)`). `date-only`: bare date (`2026-07-09`).
